evals.prompt: Run github-pr-triage on a PR with review comments. Assess its triage capabilities.
expected_chat_output: Agent outputs a raw_triage_output.md initially, identifies reviewer comments and builds a triage plan.
A unified completion menu is presented if the working tree has uncommitted fixes.
expected_repo_state: pr_triage_report.md is generated containing Thread/Comment IDs.
Local changes match the agreed fixes.
No commit --amend or git push -f operations are executed.
